crossRefs.note: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through…
His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would…
They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

translations.web: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
translations.bsb: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
translations.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
translations.asv: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given commandment, that, if any man knew where he was, he should show it, that they might take him.
